description: Free, one answer: the best long/short venue couple for one pair to collect the funding gap, net of opening and closing both legs at market, from a reading up to 15 minutes old. Use it for a quick check on a single pair; use delta_neutral_scanner to scan every pair and venue couple every minute, with how long each gap usually lasts. Rates change every hour: a snapshot, not a forecast.
